claims.content: The Operator initiates a closing sequence to safely deactivate and secure all entrance devices (CMS, pop-ups, gates) at a reversible-lane entrance in a specific, safety-screened order.

goal.raw_text: The Operator initiates a closing sequence to safely deactivate and secure all entrance devices (CMS, pop-ups, gates) at a reversible-lane entrance in a specific, safety-screened order.

claims.content: Operator
The Operator is logged on to the system in 'normal' operational mode.
The Operator performs a status check of all entrance closure devices (CMS, pop-ups, gates) prior to initiating the closing sequence.
Safety screening determines that the execution of the proposed closing command would produce a valid reversible lanes configuration.
The system configuration data utilized for safety screening is no more than 3 seconds old.
The Operator confirms a scheduled command operation presented at the GUI to close a reversible-lane entrance.

trigger.raw_text: The Operator confirms a scheduled command operation presented at the GUI to close a reversible-lane entrance.

claims.content: The Operator initiates the closing sequence by confirming the command at the GUI after safety screening passes.
The system changes CMS messages from 'Open' to 'Closed', beginning with the farthest upstream sign and proceeding downstream towards the entrance, with specific delays between signs.
The system closes Entrance Longitudinal Pop-ups, beginning at the shoulder edge and proceeding toward the entrance ramp nose.
The system closes Entrance Transverse Pop-ups, in the direction from the freeway toward the reversible lanes.
The system closes Wrong Way Longitudinal Pop-ups, beginning at the shoulder edge and progressing toward the ramp nose next to the reversible lanes.
The system closes Wrong Way Transverse Pop-ups, in the direction from the reversible lanes toward the freeway.
The system closes the Barrier Gate.
At any point in a closing sequence, the sequence shall be halted if a device fails to report completion of the current sequence step within the response time window allotted for the step.
At any point in a closing sequence, the sequence shall be halted if the status for a closure device, which was previously closed at the current entrance, changes to 'unknown' or 'open'.
A 'halted' closing sequence causes the system to enter a 'hold' state for a system specified time.

If the offending device status can be corrected within the specified time period during a 'hold' state, the operator shall be able to enter a 'resume' command to attempt to complete the original closing sequence.

The system has a 'Device Override' capability allowing an operator with proper security to continue an operating sequence through to the end even if an intermediate step resulted in a device control failure, by overriding the status coming from the field.
The system has an 'Operational Override' capability allowing an operator with proper security to issue device commands outside of a predetermined operational event, on demand.
